messages.title: A note from the developer
messages.body: Thanks for trying Chess Academy Pro — it's a brand-new app and I'm working on it every single day. I can see the issues some of you are hitting in my logs, and I'm actively fixing them right now. Please be patient with me while I do. Every piece of feedback you send is read and genuinely considered for changes to the app — so if something feels off, tell me. Thank you for being here this early. — David
